designationHistory.name: Lake Umbagog National Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1992 with the first federal land purchase at Lake Umbagog, after a cooperative effort by Maine, New Hampshire, conservation groups and timber companies.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Umbagog National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Federal Register, Dec. 3, 2008 (E8-28649), Lake Umbagog NWR CCP: "Our first purchase of land for the refuge established it in 1992"

review.note: Year confirmed. The refuge was called Lake Umbagog NWR until renamed Umbagog NWR in 2009 (FWS story, Mar. 2009).

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The refuge was established in 1992 as a result of a long-term cooperative effort between the states of Maine and New Hampshire, conservation organizations, timber companies, and the U.S.
